purpose: TEST_ONLY source-bound ranged attack-roll query; no attack command, ammunition consumption, damage application, or Overwatch reaction ordering.

sources.locators: Making an Attack; Attack Rolls; Unseen Attackers and Targets; Ranged Attacks; Cover (source text lines 8157-8219)

decisions: Ranged attack modifiers use Dexterity and add proficiency only when the caller supplies proficiency; caller-supplied flat modifiers remain explicit.
Half cover adds 2 AC, three-quarters cover adds 5 AC, and total cover blocks direct targeting.

Long range, an unseen target, and an eligible visible hostile within 5 feet contribute disadvantage; an unseen attacker contributes advantage; any advantage and disadvantage cancel to a normal d20 roll.

Target location and clear line of fire are explicit caller facts. If unavailable, the query fails without consuming a die; this is a fail-closed query boundary, not a new rule about all unseen spaces.
Existing condition-derived advantage, disadvantage and critical-on-hit results are incorporated; hit damage and state mutation are excluded.

packageStatic.scope: Static package structure only; not Unity import, compilation or release-build validation

limits: TEST_ONLY query; no production runtime selection or release approval.
No weapon or hand legality, action/reaction authority, target-state validation, ammunition, magazine, loading, damage or mutation.
Line of fire, visibility, location and cover are supplied facts, not derived tactical geometry.
Soldier Overwatch cross-reaction ordering and its 1d8+DEX versus selected-weapon damage interaction remain unresolved.
Unity import/compilation, Edit Mode, Play Mode, scene integration, standalone build and gameplay were not run.
